questionnaires.title: Exploring Questions Worksheet (CPT)
questionnaires.description: A CPT worksheet for examining a Stuck Point systematically through a series of questions. The client picks one Stuck Point and answers the questions that apply in order to challenge it.

items.text: Choose one Stuck Point to examine and write it here. The questions that follow will help you challenge it — not every question fits every belief, so answer as many as you can without repeating yourself.
What do you mean? Write the Stuck Point clearly enough that a stranger would understand exactly what is troubling you.
What is the evidence against this Stuck Point?
What information are you not including about your Stuck Point?
Does your Stuck Point include all-or-none terms (such as “all,” “never”) or extreme words or phrases (such as “need,” “should,” “must,” “can’t,” and “every time”)?
In what way is your Stuck Point overfocused on just one piece of the event?
How is the source of information for this Stuck Point questionable?
How is your Stuck Point confusing something that is possible with something that is definite?
In what ways is your Stuck Point based on feelings, rather than facts?
